title: fix(toggle): pass isRefined to toggleRefinement
body:
Was broken since perf improvements: we did not wanted to bind the
function with isRefined in render() to avoid generating new function
references each time.

But we still need it, so passed all the way down from RefinementListItem

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @pixelastic, @bobylito and @redox to be potential reviewers
Overall it's great! I like the renaming of e to originalevent. We should now go through all the code base and make it a convention :)
